name: get_scheduler_events
description: Fetch time-based reminder alerts (APScheduler), not calendar events or meetings, between start_date and end_date (ISO 8601). A one-week window starting today suits most needs; a single day when only that date matters.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 local time (e.g. 2024-12-31T00:00:00).

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 local time.

arguments_prompt:
- **Arguments**:
  - `start_date` (str, required): Start of the reminder window.  Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-31T17:00:00").
  - `end_date` (str, required): End of the reminder window.  Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-31T17:00:00").

  Typically use a range of one week (One week starting from today).  Larger ranges than a week are not advisable. If you have a very good reason you can try a larger range.
  If you only need reminders for one day then one day range is best.
